channel.title: Black Panther Store - Minimalist Shirts
channel.description: Daily featured design for Minimalist Shirts

item.title: White Tiger from India - Black colour T-Shirt
item.description: The white tiger or bleached tiger is a pigmentation variant of the Bengal tiger. They are spotted in the wild from time to time in the Indian states of Madhya Pradesh, Assam, West Bengal, Bihar and Odisha in the Sunderbans region, and especially in the former State of Rewa. White tigers also appear frequently in literature, video games, television and comic books. Truly one of nature’s most beautiful creatures. I played around with some filters to create these stunning images of the white tiger from India.

item.title: Zentangle Art - Pink & Green colours T-Shirt
item.description: The name “Zentangle” was formulated by Rick Roberts, a former monk and Maria Thomas, a very well qualified calligrapher, an illuminast, artist and designer. Zentangle art is easy to learn, relaxing and a fun way to create beautiful images by drawing lots of different structured patterns. The patterns are called tangles and consist out of combinations of dots, lines, simple curves, s-curves and orbs. These simple shapes are the "elemental strokes" and the patterns are drawn on small pieces of paper called "tiles." The tiles can be assemble into mosaics which makes this art even more stunning to look at. This particular design were modified into colour with software, to create colour zentangle artwork.
